title: US Visa Types Library
description: Explore comprehensive information about different US visa categories. Click on any visa type to learn about eligibility requirements, application process, and benefits.

cta.title: Need Help Choosing the Right Visa?
cta.description: Our immigration experts can help you determine which visa category fits your situation best.

B1.name: Business Visitor
B1.description: Business visitor visa for temporary business activities in the United States.

B2.name: Tourist Visitor
B2.description: Tourist visa for pleasure, vacation, or visiting family and friends.

F1.name: Student
F1.description: Student visa for academic studies at accredited US institutions.

F2.name: Student Dependent
F2.description: Dependent visa for spouses and unmarried children under 21 of F1 students.

H1B.name: Specialty Occupation Worker
H1B.description: Specialty occupation visa for professionals with bachelor's degree or higher.

H2A.name: Agricultural Worker
H2A.description: Temporary agricultural worker visa for seasonal farm labor.

H4.name: H1B Dependent
H4.description: Dependent visa for spouses and unmarried children under 21 of H1B visa holders.

J1.name: Exchange Visitor
J1.description: Exchange visitor visa for cultural exchange programs.

L1A.name: Intracompany Transferee Executive
L1A.description: Intracompany transferee visa for managers and executives.

L1B.name: Intracompany Transferee Specialist
L1B.description: Intracompany transferee visa for employees with specialized knowledge.

L2.name: L1 Dependent
L2.description: Dependent visa for spouses and unmarried children under 21 of L1 visa holders.

O1.name: Extraordinary Ability
O1.description: Extraordinary ability visa for individuals with exceptional skills.

TN.name: NAFTA Professional
TN.description: NAFTA professional visa for Canadian and Mexican citizens.

E2.name: Treaty Investor
E2.description: Treaty investor visa for substantial investment in US business.

EB1.name: Priority Workers
EB1.description: First preference employment-based green card for priority workers.

EB2.name: Advanced Degree Professionals
EB2.description: Second preference employment-based green card for advanced degree holders.

EB3.name: Skilled Workers
EB3.description: Third preference employment-based green card for skilled workers.

EB4.name: Special Immigrants
EB4.description: Fourth preference employment-based green card for special immigrants.

EB5.name: Immigrant Investors
EB5.description: Fifth preference employment-based green card for investors.
